tools.name: get_seo_briefing
tools.description: Use this first when the user asks what to do with SEO today, what changed, or what to focus on. Returns the top actions, recent rank moves, plan limits, and the next automatic check.

tools.name: find_quick_wins
tools.description: Use when the user asks for low-hanging fruit, quick wins, or striking-distance keywords. Each result includes the estimated monthly clicks gained by moving up.

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Use for best opportunities across quick wins, research ideas, competitor gaps, rank drops, and AI Overview citation gaps. Filter with kinds when the user names one of those.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List the user's BudgetSEO projects, keyword counts, whether a project is paused by the plan, and how many keyword slots remain.

tools.name: get_rank_changes
tools.description: Winners and losers over a recent window. Use for what moved, what dropped, or a weekly review. days defaults to 7.

tools.name: get_keyword_action_plan
tools.description: Deep context for one tracked keyword: ranking URL, history, SERP features, competitors, and a checklist. Use after a briefing when an agent can edit the page. Confirm with the user before changing the site.

tools.name: get_competitor_overview
tools.description: Competitors and how many tracked keywords each one outranks the user on. Uses saved competitor data only and never starts a paid lookup. keywordsAhead is null until that competitor has been checked.

tools.name: get_ai_visibility
tools.description: Latest AI search snapshot and keywords where an AI Overview shows but does not cite the user. Pass projectId when the user has more than one project.

tools.name: track_keywords
tools.description: Add keywords to a project. Does not spend lookup credits; it uses the plan keyword slots. Confirm the keywords with the user first. countryCode defaults to the project market.

tools.name: untrack_keyword
tools.description: Remove one tracked keyword and its history. This cannot be undone. Confirm with the user before calling it.

tools.name: update_recommendation
tools.description: Mark a briefing action done, dismissed, or snoozed. Call this after the user finishes or rejects an action so later briefings skip it. snoozeUntil is YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: research_keywords
tools.description: Find new keyword ideas for one project. This spends AI research usage and is available on Starter and Pro. Confirm with the user first. The project needs an audience set in the SEO Agent.

tools.name: lookup_keywords
tools.description: Keyword ideas from one seed: volume, difficulty, and intent. Spends 6 lookup credits unless the result is already cached. Tell the user the cost and wait for a yes. This is not research_keywords.

tools.name: check_keywords
tools.description: Volume, difficulty, and intent for keywords the user names. Spends 2 lookup credits. Tell the user the cost and wait for a yes. At most 20 keywords per call.

tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: Organic keywords, estimated traffic, and top ranking URLs for a domain. Spends 4 lookup credits unless the result is already cached. Tell the user the cost and wait for a yes. countryCode defaults to US.

tools.name: lookup_backlinks
tools.description: Referring domains, backlink totals, and domain rank. Spends 3 lookup credits unless the result is already cached. Tell the user the cost and wait for a yes. spamScore is not a reason to disavow a list of URLs.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "untrack_keyword" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Remove one tracked keyword and its history. This cannot be undone. Confirm with the user before calling it.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
